build_transformer_model: build a Transformer model with ModelArgs config for token embedding and inference
create_attention_layer: create an Attention layer with fused QKV projections and grouped query attention support
create_feedforward_layer: create a FeedForward layer with SiLU activation and fused w1/w3 weight loading
run_transformer_inference: run the Transformer forward pass with token values, lengths, and KV cache for logits
create_kv_cache: create a KV cache list with make_cache for Transformer inference with specified length and device
